us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Federal judge halts Trump administration’s proposed triumphal arch
bullets: A federal judge issued a preliminary injunction Friday.
The ruling paused construction of a proposed 250-foot arch.
The project had faced legal and public-opinion challenges.

articles.title: Trump says Iran wants a deal, but not one acceptable to him
bullets: Trump addressed Iran negotiations at a Friday White House news conference.
Gulf Arab states are seeking channels to reduce hostilities.
Concerns remain over a possible return to broader conflict.

articles.title: Senate records affordability and jobs bill action before weekend
bullets: The Congressional Record logged Senate activity on November 19.
A bipartisan affordability and jobs measure was recorded in proceedings.
The Senate also recognized National Adoption Day for November 21.

articles.title: US and Venezuela sign military agreement as Washington deepens ties
bullets: The agreement came amid broader Trump administration diplomacy.
US officials framed the move as strengthening regional ties.
The development followed recent high-level hemispheric security discussions.

articles.title: Administration auctions seabed areas near American Samoa for deep-sea mining
bullets: The auction involved seabed areas around American Samoa.
The move expands federal attention on deep-sea mineral access.
The story appeared on the Wall Street Journal front page.

articles.title: Missile strike on Zelenskyy’s hometown kills two and wounds scores
bullets: A ballistic missile hit Kryvyi Rih in central Ukraine.
Officials reported two deaths and many injuries.
The attack came amid renewed diplomacy over the war.

articles.title: UN climate talks run into overtime as countries struggle for agreement
bullets: Negotiators worked past the scheduled close of climate talks.
Disputes remained over responses to worsening global warming.
The next summit is planned for Addis Ababa in 2027.

articles.title: UN talks on AI-powered killer robots end with more talks, no binding rules
bullets: Geneva talks produced a softened agreement.
Countries extended discussions for another two years.
Advocates criticized the lack of firm limits.

articles.title: Iran tensions dominate international diplomacy after Trump remarks
bullets: Trump said Iran wants a deal, but not an acceptable one.
Regional diplomats are seeking partial de-escalation channels.
Gulf states remain concerned about renewed hostilities.

articles.title: World news brief highlights climate deadlock and major diplomatic tensions
bullets: Nearly 200 countries remained divided at climate negotiations.
International coverage focused on Ukraine, Iran, and AI risks.
The briefing summarized major global stories for November 21.

articles.title: Delhi wakes to poor air quality as AQI reaches 279
bullets: Delhi’s air quality was reported in the poor category.
The AQI reading was listed at 279.
Air pollution remained a major urban public-health concern.

articles.title: Ladakh groups press Centre as LAHDC poll timing dispute continues
bullets: The Leh Apex Body continued a protest and hunger strike.
Groups demanded dialogue with the central government.
They sought postponement of December 4 LAHDC polls to 2027.

articles.title: PM Modi to visit Lucknow for National Skills Convocation
bullets: Modi was scheduled to attend a skills convocation in Lucknow.
The event planned to felicitate 52 toppers.
The visit highlighted vocational and skills-development programs.

articles.title: India unveils first indigenous H5N1 bird flu vaccine
bullets: India announced a domestically developed H5N1 vaccine.
The vaccine targets avian influenza risks in poultry.
Officials framed it as a self-reliance milestone.

articles.title: IMD tracks Bay of Bengal system after heavy-rain alerts
bullets: A Bay of Bengal low-pressure system intensified into a depression.
IMD warned of heavy rain in eastern and southern coastal areas.
Odisha alerts extended through November 21.

articles.title: S&P 500 posts worst weekly loss in over 18 months
bullets: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% on Friday.
AI-related selling dragged major indexes lower.
The Nasdaq turned negative for 2026.

articles.title: Anthropic debut fails to stop selloff in AI trade
bullets: AI stocks sold off sharply after Anthropic’s market debut.
The broader Nasdaq suffered heavy losses Friday.
Investors questioned valuations across AI-linked names.

articles.title: Nvidia shares slide as AI-chip worries pressure markets
bullets: Nvidia remained central to the AI-stock selloff.
Chip-export policy and China exposure stayed in focus.
The decline weighed heavily on technology indexes.

articles.title: Arista and Micron rank among Friday’s notable decliners
bullets: Arista Networks and Micron were highlighted among market-cap movers.
Both stocks declined during Friday’s tech-heavy selloff.
IBM was cited as moving higher against the trend.

articles.title: IBM stands out as a relative gainer during tech rout
bullets: IBM was listed among stocks rising Friday.
Its move contrasted with declines in several AI and chip names.
The broader market still ended sharply lower.

articles.title: Anthropic goes public as AI valuation debate intensifies
bullets: Anthropic’s stock-market debut drew major investor attention.
The IPO coincided with heavy AI-sector volatility.
The company’s CEO was cited in coverage of a math breakthrough.

articles.title: SanDisk falls after negative NAND pricing forecast
bullets: SanDisk dropped 8.8% in Friday morning trading.
TrendForce released a negative NAND flash pricing forecast.
The stock reached a session low of $85.71.

articles.title: Insmed shares jump after deal news lifts market value
bullets: Insmed shares rose 20.6% after the news.
The move lifted its market capitalization to $31.7 billion.
Axios highlighted the stock reaction in its Pro Rata briefing.

articles.title: Trump threatens penalties for US companies building foreign data centers
bullets: Trump said companies could face a major tax penalty.
The proposal targets data-center construction outside the US.
The policy is aimed at countering China’s AI infrastructure push.

articles.title: Mortgage rates rise, ending four-week slide
bullets: The average 30-year mortgage rate rose to 7.28%.
The increase ended a four-week decline.
Housing affordability remains under market pressure.

articles.title: Anthropic worker says AI helped solve major math problem
bullets: An Anthropic employee claimed progress on a long-standing math problem.
The announcement intersected with Anthropic’s stock-market debut.
Experts cautioned that verification may take significant time.

articles.title: UN countries fail to set binding limits on autonomous weapons
bullets: AI-powered weapons talks ended without firm restrictions.
Negotiators agreed to continue discussions for two years.
Critics said the outcome leaves dangerous systems unchecked.

articles.title: Treasury says current Nvidia China chip-export restrictions are sufficient
bullets: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent discussed Nvidia exports on CNBC.
He said proper chip restrictions are already in place.
The issue remains central to US-China technology policy.

articles.title: Recent tech outages raise concerns over AI-era infrastructure resilience
bullets: Outages and technology errors have piled up across sectors.
Experts cited stresses from large-scale AI services.
Digital infrastructure was not originally built for current AI demands.

articles.title: GTA dominates attention as Axios says gaming story ‘hijacks America’
bullets: Axios highlighted Grand Theft Auto’s national cultural impact.
The story appeared in its November 20 morning briefing.
Gaming remained a major consumer-tech and media business focus.
